, REGEXP_SUBSTR ('(a b )', "\(\w\S\w\S\)") AS (2

, REGEXP_SUBSTR ('(a,b.)’, "\(\w\s\w\s\)') AS C3

, REGEXP_SUBSTR ('(a,b.)', "\(\w\S\w\S\)') AS C4
FROM DUAL;
